package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for large_h_payload_built_only_for_json_response: Large gin.H payloads built as transient dynamic maps right before JSON rendering.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.

func scenario322Positive(c *gin.Context) {
	users := []string{"alice", "bob", "charlie", "dave", "eve", "frank"}
	orders := []int{1001, 1002, 1003, 1004, 1005}
	stats := map[string]int{"total": 5000, "active": 420, "pending": 125}

	payload := gin.H{
		"users":      users,
		"orders":     orders,
		"stats":      stats,
		"page":       1,
		"page_size":  50,
		"total":      5000,
		"filter":     "active",
		"sort_by":    "created_at",
		"sort_order": "desc",
		"metadata": gin.H{
			"request_id":   "req-abc-123",
			"elapsed_ms":   42,
			"cached":       false,
			"api_version":  "v2",
			"region":       "us-east-1",
			"environment":  "production",
		},
	}
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, payload)
}
